decisions.reason: The responsive template costs little to maintain and complements the hosting platform, but it has not been visible since 2019 and the firm already dropped the similar shop template, so a withdrawal is plausible even though persistence remains the default.
Premium support embodies the firm's publicly announced agency-focused, round-the-clock expert service, so dropping it would contradict its core positioning.
The version management tool reflects sunk in-house development and was given its own page, and it reduces recurring operational work for agencies, which justifies continued commitment.

Scalable agency hosting is the flagship shown on the home page and central to the announced strategy, so management is strongly committed to it and would attribute any weak results to temporary ramp-up.
